title: Code station
description: The learner predicts an output, finds a line or fixes a bug; Planish takes the answer from running the code or from the language server, never from the lesson.

title.description: A short title the learner sees.

after.description: Ids of earlier parts the learner should finish first.

prompt.description: The task, as the learner sees it.

call.description: predict-output only: the call to run, in the code's language.

symbol.description: find-line only: the symbol whose definition is the line to find.

bug.description: fix-bug only: where the bug comes from, and the test that catches it.

fixCommit.description: A commit that fixed a real bug; Planish undoes its fix in a scratch copy. Give this or plantedChange.

plantedChange.description: A unified diff that plants a bug. Give this or fixCommit.

test.description: The existing test that catches the bug.

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter; unique in the lesson.

file.description: A path relative to the project's root, with forward slashes.

cite.description: The lines of code that bear this out.
